question: Da Gama avocado oil brand company owner manufacturer
markdown:
Da Gama Avocado Oil is produced by
Da Gama Avocado Oil Ltd
(also known as Da Gama Oils), a major processing facility located in
White River, Mpumalanga province, South Africa
. It functions as one of the world's prominent bulk producers of extra virgin and refined avocado oil.
Company Details
Location:
White River, Mpumalanga, South Africa
Operations:
Processes local and regional crops into cold-pressed extra virgin avocado oil, refined avocado oil, macadamia oil, guacamole, and dried fruit derivatives.
Sector:
Serves global retail, supermarket chains, catering, and cosmetic sectors.
